text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and I’d love to help bring your startup idea to life.

Your project sounds like a strong fit for my background. I have 6 years of experience building machine learning and NLP solutions, and I’m comfortable working across Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, XGBoost, pandas, and general machine learning workflows. I’m especially interested in building systems that turn a clear product idea into something practical, reliable, and user-friendly.

For your two major builds—a ChatGPT-style clone with special features and a QA bot builder based on GPT-3—I’d approach them with a focus on clean architecture, fast iteration, and making sure the core logic is implemented correctly from the start. Since you already have the logic ready, I can help translate that into a working product and build out the features around it in a structured way.

A relevant project I completed was a contract clause search assistant for the legal industry. I built an assistant that answers questions over 9,000 contracts and always quotes the clause and page it used. The system achieved a faithfulness score of 0.91 on a 120-question lawyer-written test set, and it reduced clause lookup time from 25 minutes to 3 minutes. That project required careful use of retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search, and strong attention to answer quality—experience that translates well to your GPT-based products.

What I can bring to your startup:
- solid experience building AI/NLP applications
- practical implementation of GPT-style workflows
- structured development for search, QA, and assistant systems
- a focus on accuracy, usability, and maintainability

I’d be happy to discuss your logic, the feature set you want for each project, and how best to turn it into a working Bubble-based product.
